pass_if_ALL.book: mean delta per signal (skipped -> 0 instead of net) >= +1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL.both_halves: book delta > 0 in the first and the second half of the days
pass_if_ALL.kept_quality: kept signals' mean net > all signals' mean net

after_pass: build the skip behind a switch (default off) reading SPY minute closes from the live tape (market_tape); under the operator's 11/18 rule a PASS ships (paper) - the next session's experiment
caveats: minute bars with a fixed 10-minute exit, not the desk's trail; the broker-trade result that motivated it is NOT re-used here
